newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Ark Sec to start broking unlisted stocks.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Ark Sec to start broking unlisted stocks.

text.p: Regional Japanese brokerage Ark Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday that it will start broking unlisted shares in companies set up by venture capitalists on July 1.
The plan follows the recent decision by the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) to allow securities houses to start trading unlisted stocks.

An Ark spokesman told Reuters that the brokerage will start the broking operation for individual investors. Ark, based in Aichi prefecture in central Japan, plans to deal with 20 companies at the beginning, and later raise the number of firms to 500 in five years, it said.
